sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the different concepts and procedures for grounding measuring 
 and testing techniques P1 to be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 
 in the title block.

This first draft initiated and tested by eng. Rabie Salama Ebrahim, 
 reviewed by eng. Hussein Mahros, accepted by eng. Selim Ahmad Aly Selim, 
 approved by eng. Abd El-Naby Abd El-Ghany Abd El-Naby and certified by eng. 
 Mohamed Osama Soliman HPGC inspection and quality control general 
 manager & MPIS coordinator .
General

The primary purposes of grounding for circuits, cables, 
equipment, and systems are to prevent shock hazard, protection of circuits and 
equipment, and reduction of electromagnetic interference (EMI) due to 
electromagnetic (EM) field, common ground impedance, or other from of 
interference coupling the various grounding systems used (lightning power, 
and/or signal) are integral parts of a facility or system whether they involve 
vehicles such as automobiles, ships, missiles, or aircraft; buildings; or 
building complexes. Like other facility components, grounding networks are 
exposed to the ambient EM environment this environment includes many sources 
ranging from incident radio frequency (RF) signals to lightning and from 
atmospheric noise to internally generated stray currents
